description: This file defines the Payments class, which provides methods for financial cash flow calculations such as annuities and interest payments within a PHP spreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: Payments
classes.description: A class providing static methods to compute financial cash flows, including annuity payments and interest payments for periods.

methods.name: annuity
methods.description: Calculates the constant payment (annuity) for a cash flow with a fixed interest rate over a number of periods.

methods.name: interestPayment
methods.description: Calculates the interest payment for a specific period in an investment with periodic, constant payments and interest rate.
